title: PIMP Activation
concept_summary: Built as modern acoustic / indie-folk, it stays with someone staying put after the feeling already went flat. The pressure comes from an ending that already happened while the reaction drains out slower than the room does. It leaves the release in the reaction thinning out instead of breaking open.

signal_stack.identity: someone staying in the room after the feeling already burned off
signal_stack.emotional_arc: Hot start -> numb drift -> almost no reaction
